description: Disproved legacy bank retained as a migration tombstone. 0x545200 is not an independent table.
verification_method: Thumb consumer 0x0806D964 proves one 63-record table at 0x545068; 0x545200 is physical record 25 + 8 bytes.
notes: The former 18 records were overlapping, misaligned slices of the real growth table. They are intentionally removed to prevent false ROM identity and unsafe write-back.
